features: 500W Powerful boAt Signature Sound: Transform your home into a high-octane theater arena with a massive 500W RMS peak output. Precision-engineered to project iconic boAt Signature Sound, this system floods your living room with chest-thumping bass, wide spatial dynamics, and crystal-clear high frequencies for an unbeatable cinematic rush.

5.1 Channel Surround Sound: Upgrade your home entertainment setup to a true cinema layout with an expansive 5.1 channel matrix. This multidirectional speaker configuration casts rich, spatial audio across your entire living space, ensuring every dramatic movie line, subtle background effect, and musical note wraps around you with stunning realism.

Wired Subwoofer & Dual Rear Satellites: Feel every dramatic explosion and beat with a punchy wired subwoofer paired with twin wired rear satellite speakers. The dedicated bass unit drives deep, earth-shaking low frequencies, while the rear satellites create a true rear-soundstage effect to pull you directly into the center of the action.

Multi-Compatibility (BT v5.4, HDMI ARC, USB, AUX, Optical): Link your entire digital ecosystem without input bottlenecks. Featuring ultra-stable Bluetooth v5.4 alongside physical HDMI ARC, Optical, AUX, and USB ports, this versatile soundbar connects instantly to smart TVs, gaming consoles, set-top boxes, and mobile devices.

Entertainment EQ Modes (Movie, News, Music): Tailor your acoustic output according to what you are watching. Built-in Equalizer profiles optimize the audio frequencies at the press of a button, enhancing deep bass and surround effects during action blockbusters, crisp vocal clarity during news broadcasts, and rich acoustics during music streams.

Master Remote Control: Take total, effortless command over your home theater system right from the comfort of your couch. The included full-function remote puts master volume adjustments, bass and treble tuning, source toggles, and EQ preset switches directly at your fingertips.

Sleek Design and Premium Finish: Elevate your living room aesthetic with a modern soundbar chassis. Crafted with a premium textured finish and sleek angular lines, it sits elegantly under your television or mounts cleanly on the wall, adding a touch of high-end sophistication to your home theater setup.
